# daemon-subcommand-baseline.txt — generated by scripts/check-daemon-subcommand-versions.sh --update
#
# Every (shell file, loom-daemon subcommand) dependency that predates the
# `# requires-daemon:` convention (#8285), grandfathered. A file may DROP a
# pair freely; it may not gain a new one without declaring the minimum daemon
# version in the file itself. Do NOT hand-add a row to fit a new dependency —
# that is the ratchet slipping. Write the marker instead:
#
#   # requires-daemon: <subcommand> >= <version>   <why / which PR added it>
#   # requires-daemon: <subcommand> optional       <how it degrades>
#
# A pair the file DECLARES is deliberately absent from this ledger — the
# declaration supersedes the grandfather, and carrying both would let a
# later deletion of the marker pass unnoticed.
#
# Format: one <path><TAB><subcommand> per line.
